name: invoice-reconciliation
description: Supplier invoice reconciliation for produce wholesalers: shared parsing/matching core, React UI that reads invoices in the browser, static AWS hosting, AI fallback backend for unreadable formats

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix core && CUSTOMER=teena-rimon npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix infra && npm run typecheck --prefix backend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix core && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix infra && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix core && npm test --prefix infra && npm test --prefix backend
